lines: +pnpm now fails with `ERR_PNPM_AUTH_INVALID_BASE64` when a registry's `_password` in `.npmrc` is not valid base64. Previously it sent the value as the raw password. A `username` or `_password` left empty, for example by an unset environment variable, now supplies no credential [#16273](https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/issues/16273).
